title: Community Gateway: 33 Identical £20K Payments Across Three Departments

title: Preston's Year-End Rush: 4.6x Spending Spike in Customer Services

title: One Company, All the Road Sweepers: Aebi Schmidt's £799K Monopoly
summary: Aebi Schmidt UK is the sole supplier for road sweeping vehicles at Preston — 3 contracts, £799K, zero competition. A £422K reorder in 2025/26 suggests continued sole-source procurement. Were alternatives like Johnston or Faun ever evaluated?

title: 13 Suppliers, £1.1M, and No Companies House Registration

title: Conlon Construction: From £154K to £5.4M in Four Years

title: Matrix SCM: 5,445 Payments and the Agency Staffing Question

title: Eric Wright at Preston: The £38M Connection to Burnley's Pioneer Place
summary: Maple Grove Developments received £31.5M from Preston — 15.4% of all spending. Maple Grove is a subsidiary of Eric Wright Group, the same entity behind Burnley's £56.5M Pioneer Place project. Combined Eric Wright spend at Preston: £38.2M.

title: Who Is 'Redacted Personal Information'? 1,214 Payments and £1M Hidden
summary: Preston paid £1.01M to a supplier recorded only as 'REDACTED PERSONAL INFORMATION' — 1,214 payments at 4.1-day intervals. The same redaction pattern appears at Pendle (£871K). Combined: £1.88M in hidden spending across two election councils.
